about: Every third-party component in the Daedalus repository. THIRD_PARTY.md is generated from this file by scripts/hygiene/third_party.py; the hygiene check fails when a folder in neo/libs or neo/extern, or a font in content, isn't listed here. Full license texts are in LICENSE_EXCEPTIONS.md and next to each component.

components.name: Doom 3 BFG Edition GPL source and RBDOOM-3-BFG
components.license: GPL-3.0 with id Software's additional terms
components.use: The engine Daedalus is built on

components.name: Dear ImGui (with ImGuizmo)
components.use: Built in: the editor's interface and gizmos

components.name: ImTui (with PDCurses)
components.use: Not built

components.name: BinPack2D
components.use: Built in: packing rectangles into texture atlases

components.name: FFmpeg (prebuilt for Windows)
components.use: Optional, off by default (FFMPEG): Bink videos use libbinkdec instead

components.name: irrXML
components.use: Built in: reading XML

components.name: Intel ISPC Texture Compressor
components.use: Built in: compressing textures

components.name: libbinkdec
components.use: Built in: playing Bink videos
components.notes: LGPL code may be used under the GPL, as here.

components.name: Mesa R11G11B10 helpers
components.use: Built in: packing HDR colours

components.name: MinGW compatibility headers
components.license: MIT (sal.h, from PortAudio); LGPL-2.1+ (Wine dsound and XInput headers)

components.name: Mikkelsen tangent space (MikkTSpace)

components.name: Ogg Vorbis
components.use: Built in: playing .ogg sounds

components.name: Optick

components.name: RapidJSON

components.name: RenderDoc in-application API header

components.name: stb (image, image write, image resize)

components.name: TinyEXR (with OpenEXR parts)
